// PROBE FIXTURE for tests/unit/empty-extraction-never-active.test.ts.
// The exact defect shape: an extraction result is written straight to
// `status: "active"` with no emptiness check, so a one-line PDF with no
// policy details becomes an active policy with a placeholder identity.
// The guard must flag this file. Committed per the "guards must enumerate,
// not assume" rule in CLAUDE.md — a guard without a probe proven to turn it
// red is not a guard.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { getAIService } from "@/lib/services/ai"

export async function probeUnchecked(policyId: string, document: unknown) {
    const extraction = await getAIService().extractPolicyData(document as any, { policyId })
    await db.policy.update({
        where: { id: policyId },
        data: {
            insurerName: extraction.insurerName,
            policyNumber: extraction.policyNumber,
            status: "active",
        },
    })
}
